# NXLabTW

> NXLabTW is a Taiwan-based web design and development team building websites with usability, maintainability, and security in mind.

## Official website

- [NXLabTW](https://nxlabtw.com/): Company, services, projects, official profiles, and contact information.

## Services

- Company websites, landing pages, and web tools for small businesses and teams.
- Security considerations include data handling, access permissions, and checks before launch.
- Website project inquiries: mail@nxlabtw.com

## Projects

- [AtlasNote](https://atlasnote.nxlabtw.com/): Online notebook for text and images, with cross-device access and optional encryption.
- [Neutron — ACMTN](https://neutron.nxlabtw.com/): Private, browser-encrypted conversations through the Advanced Confidential Message Transfer Network.
- [Browzen](https://github.com/NeuralNexusLab-nh/Browzen): Portable Windows browser with Chromium rendering, Tor routing, relay-route inspection, and configurable security levels.
